pin_number_policy: Pin numbers are the LOGICAL terminal names from design/v3/magnetics/winding_polarity.csv, not physical pad numbers. The checklist forbids inventing a '1-5' sequence: a fabricated number in a finished symbol is indistinguishable from a verified terminal drawing. Physical pad numbers stay null in magnetics_symbol_contract.json until the winding house returns a terminal drawing.
footprint_note: lib_Device.modify() returns false for every association and property form in this build, so a device-level footprint cannot be written headlessly. The placed instance carries a Footprint property instead; without it sch_ManufactureData.getNetlistFile() returns null for the whole sheet. The footprints below are placeholders chosen for pad count and body size, not vendor parts.

DCX_XFMR_5P.description: DCX 24:1 centre-tapped transformer, 5 logical terminals; physical terminal drawing UNVERIFIED

DCX_CT_4P.description: DCX current transformer, 4 logical terminals; vendor pinout and polarity UNVERIFIED

known_mismatches: CT: the symbol has 4 logical terminals but the placeholder footprint exposes 2 pads. It is placed so the schematic is complete and the netlist can be diffed; PCB import and pad mapping for CT stay blocked until a real terminal drawing exists.
